description: This file defines a Protocol interface for checkpointable objects in PyTorch's distributed module. It specifies methods that checkpointable objects should implement to support serialization and tensor sharding functionality.

classes.name: _Checkpointable
classes.description: A Protocol interface for checkpointable objects supporting checkpointing and tensor sharding.

methods.name: list[object] __create_write_items__(self, fqn: str, object: object)
methods.description: Generates a list of items to write based on the object's contents.

methods.name: list[object] __create_chunk_list__(self)
methods.description: Returns a list of chunk storage metadata based on the object's contents.

methods.name: torch.Tensor __get_tensor_shard__(self, index: int)
methods.description: Retrieves a tensor shard based on an index, supporting distributed tensor sharding.

ctags.name: __create_write_items__
ctags.pattern: /^    def __create_write_items__(self, fqn: str, object: object) -> list[object]:$/
